strategies.name: Golden Glide Trend Capture
strategies.description: This strategy follows intermediate-term trend persistence by buying when a faster moving average crosses above a slower one. It is designed to stay aligned with sustained upside while using a defined stop to limit damage during sharp reversals.
strategies.entry_rule: Enter a long position when the 20-day simple moving average crosses above the 100-day simple moving average and the close is above both moving averages.
strategies.exit_rule: Exit the position when the 20-day simple moving average crosses below the 100-day simple moving average or when price falls 8.0% below the entry price, whichever occurs first.
strategies.reasoning: GOOGL is trading above both its 50-day and 200-day averages, with strong 30-day and 90-day returns indicating an established uptrend. A medium-speed crossover is suitable because the stock has delivered strong annualized returns but also shows meaningful drawdown risk, making a stop-loss important.
